reasons.certificate_names_the_major: The program's page prints the associate degree's major and, under 'Certificate of Achievement', one sentence: a student who completes only the major's courses qualifies for the certificate. The certificate prints no list of its own, and the text the filed read was given ends where that sentence begins, so the extraction, asked for the certificate, records no list; a forced re-read would send the same text. It waits on a reader change (the text the capture sends for a certificate that shares its degree's page).

The filed record (run 39061728041) notes that its text 'is cut off at Certificate o'. The page's two figures, 24 and 25-27, differ.
